caption:
TradingView just launched an official connector for Claude (public beta). Here's the 60-second setup + 6 prompts to try. Not financial advice.

#tradingview #claude #ai #trading #aitools

slides.title: TradingView is now inside Claude.
slides.sub: The official connector just launched. Here's the 60-second setup and 6 prompts to try today.
slides.voiceover: TradingView just launched an official connector for Claude. Here's how to use it.

slides.label: What happened
slides.title: An official TradingView connector for AI assistants
items: Claude web, desktop, mobile & Claude Code
ChatGPT, Codex and other MCP clients
slides.voiceover: It's in public beta on paid plans, and it works in Claude Code too.

slides.label: Setup · 60 seconds
slides.title: Connect it in 3 steps
steps: Authorize with your TradingView account. Done.
slides.voiceover: Add a custom connector, paste the server URL, and sign in.

slides.label: Market data + news
slides.name: The Ticker Briefing
slides.prompt: Give me a full briefing on [TICKER]: price action over the last 3 months, the latest news headlines, and upcoming earnings or dividend dates. End with the 3 things I should watch this week.
slides.note: Uses price history, news and calendar tools together.
slides.voiceover: Get a full briefing on any ticker, with news and earnings dates.

slides.label: Screener
slides.name: The Stock Hunter
slides.prompt: Run a screen for [MARKET] stocks with market cap above [X], P/E below [Y] and a positive technical rating. Show the top 10 in a table and explain why each one passed.
slides.note: Describe filters in plain language. No screener menus.
slides.voiceover: Screen stocks in plain English, no filter menus.

slides.label: Filings & transcripts
slides.name: The Earnings Prep
slides.prompt: [COMPANY] reports soon. Summarize its last earnings call transcript and latest filing: guidance, risks management mentioned, and what analysts will likely focus on.
slides.voiceover: Summarize the last earnings call and the latest filing.

slides.label: Watchlists
slides.name: The Watchlist Builder
slides.prompt: Create a watchlist called [NAME] with the 15 largest companies in the [SECTOR] sector. Then tell me which of them report earnings in the next 30 days.
slides.note: It can create and edit your real watchlists.
slides.voiceover: Build real watchlists, right from the chat.

slides.label: Alerts
slides.name: The Alert Setter
slides.prompt: Set a price alert on [TICKER] when it crosses [PRICE]. Then list all my active alerts and flag any that look outdated compared to the current price.
slides.note: Alert conditions can't be edited, only deleted and recreated.
slides.voiceover: Set price alerts, and spot the outdated ones.

slides.label: Macro
slides.name: The Macro Radar
slides.prompt: What are the most important economic events this week? For each one, explain in simple terms how it could move [ASSET] and what surprise would matter most.
slides.note: Economic calendar looks ahead about 31 days.
slides.voiceover: See this week's key economic events, explained simply.

slides.label: Know the limits
slides.title: Before you rely on it
items: Market data is delayed, not real-time
It reads data and manages lists & alerts. It doesn't place trades
AI can be wrong. This is not financial advice
slides.cta: Follow for daily AI tool news
slides.voiceover: The data is delayed, and it can't place trades. Not financial advice.
